items.title: Scope private endpoint connection update and delete to HorizonDb clusters
items.summary: The authoritative single review unit supplies HorizonDbCluster to the private endpoint operation templates, associating private endpoint connection update and delete lifecycle roles with a cluster parent. Both routes gain /clusters/{clusterName} and require clusterName in the unchanged 2026-01-20-preview API version (baseline 397a6977353e62db503b266fd796f51d14d60ef6; target b931dadcc0382a211cc8d8489f45dab5bdf858b9). SDK method identities remain exact matches; update exposes a different named result type. These are existing-version contract changes, not a version publication or an inferred model rename.

guidance.excerpt: CreateOrUpdate (PUT), Update (Patch), Delete, and Action (POST) operations over a resource may be either synchronous or asynchronous. Synchronous operations complete before a response is returned. Asynchronous operations return an initial response before the operation fully completes, and support long-running operation (LRO) polling.

documents.title: ARM long-running operations
documents.selectionRationale: ARM asynchronous update/delete result and polling metadata are modified candidate context.

guidance.excerpt:
Each header model accepts a FinalResult parameter that indicates the type of the logical result of the operation. It is important that this value matches what the operation actually returns.
The ArmCustomPatchAsync template uses ArmLroLocationHeader by default with the resource as the final result.
The ArmResourceDeleteWithoutOkAsync template uses ArmLroLocationHeader by default with void as the final result, since delete operations do not return a resource body on completion.

intentAssessments.title: Existing preview clients lose their route and parameter contract
intentAssessments.expected: Evolve operations and parameters while preserving existing clients through version-scoped changes; private endpoint operation templates take the owning parent resource. ARM asynchronous update/delete may retain location polling with a final result matching their response.
intentAssessments.actual: Adding HorizonDbCluster as the template parent correctly scopes private endpoint update/delete beneath clusters, but changes both existing routes and adds required clusterName in the same selected 2026-01-20-preview version. Async status/header behavior is preserved.
intentAssessments.rationale: The parent-resource change aligns with the fetched private endpoint examples and async lifecycle guidance, yet the selected existing-version projection does not preserve prior callers as the Evolving APIs guidance describes. No evidence proves the old documented contract was merely correcting a service-wide mismatch. This finding concerns compatibility/version isolation, not a demand to add unrelated operations or alter valid LRO polling.
intentAssessments.gap: The parent-resource change aligns with the fetched private endpoint examples and async lifecycle guidance, yet the selected existing-version projection does not preserve prior callers as the Evolving APIs guidance describes. No evidence proves the old documented contract was merely correcting a service-wide mismatch. This finding concerns compatibility/version isolation, not a demand to add unrelated operations or alter valid LRO polling.
